poc_plan: Objective: Prove Dedicated capacity can meet throughput guarantees and latency SLOs at planned commit (8 reserved GPUs)
Environment: Dedicated pool in customer VPC with 8xA100-equivalent instances; private control plane; KMS integration enabled
Load tests: ramp to 120 concurrent chat sessions over 30 minutes; sustained period at 1.2k tokens/sec for 2 hours; measure p50/p95/p99 latency
Soak tests: 48-hour continuous run at 60% of target QPS to validate memory/kv-cache stability and leak detection
Representative prompts: mix of short chat (10-40 tokens), long-context summarization (1k-2k tokens), and reranking micro-batches (batch size 32) — provided example set in Drive
Metrics to capture: token/sec, request/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency (generation & total), GPU util, tail-latency spikes, error rates, retry/fallback counts
Success criteria: p95 latency <= 180ms for short-chat path at target concurrency; p99 <= 400ms except during controlled overload; sustained throughput within +/-10% of predicted model profile
Failure criteria: repeated OOMs, >0.5% error rate, sustained GPU saturation causing >25% throughput degradation
Routing/fallback plan: automatic fallback to smaller quantized model for tail cases; measure quality delta with eval prompts
Deliverables: test report with waterfall charts, cost estimate for reserved capacity, recommended autoscaling/burst headroom, SLA draft with latency SLOs and credits
